title: Dependencies
use_cases: Use when setting up the initial environment for Claude Code orchestration
Configure when integrating Firecrawl MCP for automated web scraping
Implement when local vector similarity search and analytical storage are required
Configure when establishing a secure connection to the Anthropic API
content:
**Required:**

- [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code) - AI coding assistant that orchestrates the system
- [Firecrawl MCP](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/mcp-server) - For scraping web content
- Python 3.10+ with `uv` package manager
- Anthropic API key (for Claude analysis)

**Python packages (auto-installed):**

- `sentence-transformers` - Local embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2)
- `usearch` - Fast vector similarity search
- `duckdb` - Embedded analytics database
- `anthropic` - Claude API client
- `pydantic` - Type-safe models
